Female reference anatomy: Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP
Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein, 3D Reference Organ Set for Female v1.10 (2026).
Source: https://cdn.humanatlas.io/digital-objects/ref-organ/united-female/v1.10/assets/3d-vh-f-united.glb
Metadata: https://cdn.humanatlas.io/digital-objects/ref-organ/united-female/v1.10/metadata.json
Reference library: https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library
Underlying imagery: Visible Human Dataset, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Adaptations for Anatomi Atlas: source materials and UV attributes removed; Draco geometry compression with 14-bit position and 10-bit normal quantization; original node transforms retained; 8 pregnancy-reference meshes omitted. No smoothing, remodelling or male geometry added. Display translated to place feet on the stage. Original identifiers retained in catalog-female.json. 948 meshes.
The female reference has a body surface and selected anatomy; it is not a complete female skeleton or muscular atlas. It is a reference assembly, not a patient-specific model. Male and female sources have different coverage and cannot be used for quantitative sex comparisons.

Version 4 supplement: eight pubis/ischium compact and spongy bone meshes from the official HRA female v1.5 GLB, same creators and CC BY 4.0 license. URL: https://cdn.humanatlas.io/digital-objects/ref-organ/united-female/v1.5/assets/3d-vh-f-united.glb
Four shared ilium node world transforms match exactly; original transforms of the additional pelvis pieces preserved. Recompressed and merged into the default scene. Current catalog: 956 selectable structures. Display labels expanded for bone substructures.


Version 5 shared reference subset (2026-10-14): To improve discoverability of common anatomy absent from the HRA female reference, the female view can load selected skull, axial/upper-limb bones, trunk/upper-limb muscles, and non-lower-limb tendons from the package's Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D general atlas models. This subset is labeled in the app as a shared atlas reference. It is not female-donor anatomy and has not been spatially registered or scaled against the HRA specimen; do not use the mixed display for measurement or quantitative comparison. Geometry and associated catalog records remain subject to the attribution and CC BY-SA obligations in SOURCE-LICENSE.txt. The 367 selected shared catalog records comprise 95 skeletal, 222 muscular, and 50 tendon structures. Female external genital anatomy remains outside this source package.

Version 6 catalog correction (2026-10-14): The shared-reference selection now includes individually named wrist bones, finger/toe phalanges, foot bones and teeth, and additional face, neck, forearm, back and intrinsic foot muscles that the earlier name filter omitted. Current shared subset: 652 records (221 skeletal, 381 muscular, 50 tendon-layer structures). Total female-view catalog: 1,684 entries, including the 956 HRA reference structures and 76 lower-limb muscle supplement entries. These remain general atlas meshes, not newly created or female-donor geometry; pose and morphologic registration to HRA are not established. External genital anatomy remains absent. Source attribution and share-alike obligations remain unchanged.


Version 7 system expansion (2026-10-15): Missing common cardiovascular, peripheral nerve and sensory structures, musculoskeletal support tissues, and additional common bones/muscles are now selectable in the female view. Native HRA and female muscle records are preferred over equivalent general structures using normalized names and reviewed aliases. Generic-source male reproductive anatomy and donor-specific male pelvic-floor muscles are excluded. Connective tissues are grouped under the tendon/ligament layer while their individual tissue types remain named. Current view: 2,774 records, comprising 1,032 female-reference/supplement entries and 1,742 general-reference entries. Shared counts: skeleton 232, muscular 372, connective/tendon 217, cardiovascular 609, nervous 312. General geometry is unchanged, reuses the existing packaged GLBs, and is not registered to the HRA female donor; this is not a complete female-donor atlas. Preserve SOURCE-LICENSE.txt attribution and share-alike terms. A source-specific Latin error for the HRA left marginal coronary branch (FMA:3902) was corrected to TA2 4152, Ramus marginalis sinister arteriae circumflexae cordis, using FIPAT TA2 Part 4.
CURRENT DISPLAY CORRECTION — 2026-10-16 (supersedes mixed-view counts below):
The HRA female assembly (956 selectable meshes), the adapted female lower-limb muscle supplement (76 meshes), and the general Z-Anatomy reference are now separate source frames. They are never overlaid as one female-donor body. The separate general frame retains its own source skeleton, including pelvis/femurs, muscles, vessels, nerves and organs, with male reproductive and selected male pelvic-floor structures excluded: 2,310 UI records. These records reuse existing general-source geometry; they are not additional female-donor meshes. Their licenses remain in SOURCE-LICENSE.txt. Native HRA coverage remains incomplete. The leg supplement remains approximate and unregistered; it is not suitable for morphometric measurement. Earlier version 5–7 mixed-view counts are historical and do not describe the current source-separated display.
